description: This file defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) receive side in a 3GPP telecommunications protocol stack. It includes class declarations for handling PDCP PDUs, SDUs, control notifications, and security configuration, specifically for the receive (rx) direction.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for lower layer to pass PDUs into the PDCP receive entity.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_data_notifier
classes.description: Interface for passing SDUs from PDCP to upper layers.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers of protocol or integrity failures, max count reached, or resume required.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for configuring security, re-establishing, buffering, and controlling the receive side of PDCP.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Notify upper layers of a new SDU (Service Data Unit).

methods.name: on_integrity_failure
methods.description: Notify of an integrity check failure.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Notify when maximum count is reached.

methods.name: configure_security
methods.description: Configure security parameters for the receive side.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Get the current RX count for status transfer.

methods.name: set_count
methods.description: Set the RX count for status transfer.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notify that PDU processing has stopped.
